description: Precommitted upper control for the 3dp-ceil-versus-float damage discriminator using the supplied 2dp battle stats. WIP attacks with 325 T6 Lancers and no heroes; minxxx defends with 10 T6 Infantry and 325 T6 Marksmen and no heroes. Both the current per-attack 3dp ceiling and an otherwise identical full-float counterfactual predict minxxx wins with exactly 253 Marksmen surviving.
